tools.name: sketch_to_floorplan
tools.description: Convert a hand-drawn floor plan sketch or blueprint photo (base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP, max 8 MB) into a structured PlumbDraft FloorPlan JSON. Requires Bearer API key (pd_live_...).

tools.name: compile_floorplan_geometry
tools.description: Compile a PlumbDraft FloorPlan JSON to compute bounds, net room areas, wall linear footage, and sequential door/window tags. Free up to 10 requests/day or unlimited with Bearer API key.

tools.name: validate_clearance_ergonomics
tools.description: Run residential clearance and ergonomics checks (hallway width, door swing collisions, toilet/kitchen/bed clearances) on a FloorPlan JSON. Free up to 10 requests/day or with Bearer API key.

tools.name: calculate_material_takeoff
tools.description: Calculate a full residential material takeoff (flooring by type with waste, drywall 4x8 sheets, primer/paint gallons, baseboard sticks, door/window schedules, and cost bands). Free up to 10 requests/day or with Bearer API key.

tools.name: export_blueprint_dxf
tools.description: Export a layered AutoCAD R12 DXF blueprint (A-WALL, A-DOOR, A-GLAZ, A-FURN, A-AREA, A-ANNO-DIMS) from a FloorPlan JSON. Requires Bearer API key (pd_live_...).

tools.name: export_blueprint_pdf
tools.description: Export an architectural vector PDF blueprint (ANSI B 11x17 or US Letter, 1/4"=1'-0" or 1/8"=1'-0") as base64 from a FloorPlan JSON. Requires Bearer API key (pd_live_...).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sketch_to_floorplan" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
